name: browser-alpha-matting: Client-Side Hybrid WebGPU, CIE76 Lab & Euclidean RGB Alpha-Matting Kernel

description: Zero-dependency ES module and TypeScript computer-vision kernel executing hybrid WebGPU/WebAssembly neural saliency segmentation (RMBG-1.4), deterministic 3D Euclidean RGB and perceptual CIE76 Lab color-keying, BFS enclosed counter carving, Joint Bilateral 4K proxy-mask upsampling, separable O(W*H) morphological boundary refinement, and iterative foreground color decontamination entirely inside local browser TypedArray memory with zero network data egress.
